callees.name: _prompt
callees.pre_condition: prompt_text is a non-empty string describing the requested input.
callees.post_condition: Displays prompt_text and an optional default value to stdout, reads a line from stdin, and returns the user's input as a non-empty string. Returns the default value when the user provides empty input. Re-prompts when the input does not satisfy the validation rule for the field being collected.

callees.name: _prompt_yes_no
callees.pre_condition: prompt_text is a non-empty string describing the yes/no question.
callees.post_condition: Displays prompt_text to stdout, reads a line from stdin, and returns True when the user's response indicates affirmative, False when it indicates negative. Returns the default value when the user provides empty input.
